fornax.description: Fornax: open models in-process on your GPU, from Java. jbang fornax@fornax4j chat qwen3-4b; also image, song, speak, transcribe, see, pull, list

chat.description: Chat with a language model, downloaded on first use: jbang chat@fornax4j qwen3-4b ["prompt"]

image.description: Draw an image: jbang image@fornax4j flux2-klein "a red fox in the snow"

song.description: Make a song: jbang song@fornax4j ace-step-turbo "a folk song about rain"

speak.description: Text to speech with Kokoro: jbang speak@fornax4j "Hello from Fornax"

transcribe.description: Speech to text with Whisper: jbang transcribe@fornax4j talk.wav

see.description: Ask a vision model about an image: jbang see@fornax4j qwen3-vl-4b photo.jpg
